symptom: A verified descendant research branch existed while the sole open PR still referenced its older ancestor; earlier create-ref and unverified write routes had not attached the successor.
lesson: Creating an already-existing PR branch cannot attach a descendant commit. With confirmed repository push authority, an existing non-protected PR ref can be advanced by a non-force compare-and-swap update only after verifying ancestry and the exact current head.
guardrail: Before updating an existing PR ref, read canonical main, PR head, current ref and candidate descendant; verify behind_by=0 and ahead_by>0; call update_ref with force=false and expected_sha equal to the observed PR head; read back both PR and ref before claiming attachment. Do not interpret attachment as CI or merge readiness.
